dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL with $SET directives (preprocess htmlpp, sourceformat free), external-form linkage section, and CGI/web output pattern typical of Micro Focus Net Express or similar web-enabled COBOL
evidence: identified by clauses in PIC fields

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian NF-e (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) monitoring dashboard for distribution/logistics operations; tracks authorized, contingency, rejected, and denied electronic invoices across geographic regions and business units
purpose.summary: This program is a CGI/web-based NF-e (Brazilian electronic invoice) monitor that reads configuration files to build geographic/unit groupings, processes CSV data about NF-e statuses (authorized, rejected, contingency, DPEC, SVC), and renders an HTML panel showing NF-e processing metrics per geography and distribution center. It also supports CSV export of the monitoring data.

notable_features: IDENTIFIED BY clauses for HTML form field binding
Brazilian Portuguese variable names and comments
Multiple COPY books (PCW900, PCW0098, PCW902, PCW990)
Line sequential file I/O for CSV and CFG files
Large inline table with 30+ NF-e status counters per entry
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars out of ~96KB total. Program is clearly production-grade Brazilian fiscal/logistics software. The 'online-cics' program_type is used loosely here — it is actually a CGI web program (not CICS), but no better enum value exists. Decoded with latin-1 due to Portuguese accented characters (e.g. 'Inválido', 'Opção').
